name: mente-apex
description: Mente Apex private utilities — client onboarding, a brand-book-first client-deliverable generator (offers, proposals, agreements, licences, DPAs, handovers, update briefs — rendered to on-brand HTML/PDF from Markdown), an invoice generator, a one-step ship (branch/commit/push/PR) workflow, a clean-code review/writing standard, a SOLID analysis & guided-refactor workflow, a GoF design-pattern analysis & guided-refactor workflow (creational/structural/behavioral), a TDD (red-green-refactor) implementation workflow with feature and legacy-code modes, plus Claude config sync across machines via Git, plus a Domain-Driven Design modelling/build/analysis workflow (/ddd), a Clean Architecture component/dependency audit (/clean-architecture), and an umbrella full-audit (/code-quality) that runs all five review lenses at once and merges them into one deduplicated report.
